figures.scope: Only the source-bound three incident/refracted paths, lens crossing locations and shared focus in this apparatus figure.
figures.authoritativeRequirement: Three parallel rays from the emitter arrive vertically at the lens and converge to one point behind it.
figures.observedEvidence: The independent original-detail inspection recorded a circular face, perimeter wedges/dashes, horizontal hatching, two circular centers and an unresolved irregular center. It did not identify three continuous ray paths, their lens crossings or their common post-lens intersection.

Where each ray crosses the lens.

figures.scope: Only the directed propagation interpretation, especially panel b. Five paths per panel, common F points, lens outlines and panel identities are not declared unresolved.
figures.authoritativeRequirement: Panel a has parallel rays arriving from the left and meeting the right focus; panel b uses the opposite incident direction and meets the left focus.

sourceDetailSupplement.derivation: sips -z 873 1710 original --out owned-path; threefold resampling, not additional source detail

figures.inventoryQualification: The sealed pixel-only inventory initially interpreted the dark directional marks in both panels as left-to-right. A subsequent enlarged-source inspection does not substantiate that interpretation reliably: the thick irregular marks do not provide unambiguous arrow tips. That initial orientation statement is therefore an unverified interpretation, not an established source fact. The sealed inventory is retained unchanged, with this separate qualification.
figures.observedEvidence: Five continuous paths and a common F are visible in each panel. The left panel is parallel on the left of its lens, and the right panel is parallel on the right of its lens. These geometric incidences alone are reversible and cannot prove the actual propagation direction of the source marks.
unresolved: Unambiguous propagation direction of the source directional marks, especially whether panel b depicts right-to-left incidence as the authoritative prose requires.
figures.requiredResolution: A source-bound clarification of the printed arrow orientation, or an explicit decision authorizing a modern directional correction. The author does not silently reverse arrows, swap panel labels, or substitute a focus-as-source interpretation.
